events.name: Pittsburgh Pirates at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Jared Triolo and Jake Mangum hit run-scoring singles against Fernando Cruz in the 10th inning, Jacob Gonzalez and Nick Gonzales homered off Gerrit Cole and the Pittsburgh Pirates beat the New York Yankees 5-3 Wednesday in the opener of a day-night...
headlines.shortLinkText: Triolo, Mangum lift Pirates over Yankees 5-3 in doubleheader opener after Cole strikes out 11

events.name: Baltimore Orioles at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — The Boston Red Sox won their 15th straight game to match a club record for the longest winning streak in team history from 80 years ago, beating the Baltimore Orioles 6-3 in the opener of a split doubleheader on Wednesday afternoon.
headlines.shortLinkText: Red Sox win 15th straight, matching longest in club history, with 6-3 victory over Orioles

events.name: New York Mets at Milwaukee Brewers

headlines.description: — Joey Ortiz went 3 for 3 and was a homer away from the cycle to help the Milwaukee Brewers defeat the New York Mets 4-3 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Joey Ortiz stays hot, going 3 for 3 in the Brewers' 4-3 win over the Mets

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Salvador Perez tied the franchise home run record and Lane Thomas hit a tiebreaking, two-run single in the seventh to lift the Kansas City Royals to a 5-4 victory over the San Francisco Giants on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Salvador Perez ties the franchise home run record with his 317th as the Royals beat the Giants 5-4

headlines.shortLinkText: Nationals beat Rockies 8-0 as Cade Cavalli goes 6 strong innings and Luis García Jr. homers

headlines.description: — James McCann hit his 100th major league home run and Ryan Waldschmidt slugged the first of his career as part of Arizona's seven-run fifth inning and the Diamondbacks set a season high for runs scored in a 15-5 rout of the Athletics on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Diamondbacks set season high for runs in 15-5 rout of Athletics

headlines.description: — Sal Stewart hit a go-ahead, three-run homer in the seventh inning to lift the Cincinnati Reds past the Seattle Mariners 5-3 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Stewart’s go-ahead, 3-run home run lifts Reds to 5-3 victory over Mariners

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Hunter Dobbins scattered six hits over six innings, JJ Wetherholt hit a home run in the sixth and the St. Louis Cardinals held on for a 1-0 victory over the Los Angeles Angels on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dobbins throws 6 innings and Wetherholt homers to lead the Cardinals to a 1-0 win over Angels

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Philadelphia Phillies

headlines.description: — Max Muncy hit a go-ahead, two-run homer in the sixth inning, Tommy Edman added to the Dodgers' lead with a bases-clearing triple in the eighth, and Los Angeles beat the Philadelphia Phillies 9-5 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Max Muncy hits go-ahead homer as Dodgers beat Phillies 9-5

headlines.description: — Brooks Lee hit a three-run homer, Trevor Larnach had a solo shot and three RBI and the Minnesota Twins snapped a four-game losing streak with a 10-6 win over Cleveland on Wednesday night to spoil star
headlines.shortLinkText: Brooks Lee homers, drives in 4 as Twins topple Guardians 10-6 in José Ramírez's return from injury

events.name: Pittsburgh Pirates at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Max Fried allowed one hit over five innings in his return from a two-month layoff, Jasson Dom nguez and Anthony Volpe drove in runs on consecutive pitches in the seventh and the New York Yankees beat the Pittsburgh Pirates 2-0 Wednesday night for a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Fried allows 1 hit over 5 innings in return from IL, Yankees beat Pirates 2-0 for doubleheader split

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at Toronto Blue Jays

headlines.description: — Griffin Jax allowed one run in six strong innings, Victor Mesa Jr. drove in two runs and the Tampa Bay Rays used a three-run sixth to top the Toronto Blue Jays 4-2 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jax pitches 6 strong innings, Mesa Jr. drives in 2 as Rays down Blue Jays 4-2

events.name: Baltimore Orioles at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — The Baltimore Orioles ended Boston’s franchise record-tying 15-game winning streak behind Kyle Bradish’s six innings of one-run ball, defeating the Red Sox 5-1 in the nightcap of a doubleheader on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Orioles halt Red Sox's franchise record-tying 15 game win streak with 5-1 win to split twinbill

events.name: San Diego Padres at Atlanta Braves

headlines.description: — Rookie Jim Jarvis drilled a run-scoring double into the right-field corner to give Atlanta the lead in a six-run eighth inning and the Braves survived a ninth-inning scare to beat...
headlines.shortLinkText: Jarvis doubles in go-ahead run in 6-run 8th inning as Braves hold on in 9th to edge Padres 7-6

headlines.description: — Keider Montero and four relievers combined on a four-hitter, Hao-Yu Lee hit a three-run homer and the Detroit Tigers beat the Chicago Cubs 5-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Montero and relievers combine on a 4-hitter, Lee hits a 3-run HR and the Tigers beat the Cubs 5-1

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Chase Meidroth went 4 for 4 while he and Andrew Benintendi had a pair of run-scoring singles apiece, Anthony Kay pushed through five innings for his first win in more than a month, and the Chicago White Sox beat the Texas Rangers 4-2 on Wednesday...
headlines.shortLinkText: Meidroth and Benintendi have a pair of RBI singles apiece as White Sox beat Rangers 4-2

headlines.description: — Yordan Alvarez and Isaac Paredes hit back-to-back home runs in the eighth inning to lift the Houston Astros to a 5-2 win over the Miami Marlins on Wednesday night, completing a three-game series sweep.
headlines.shortLinkText: Alvarez and Paredes hit back-to-back homers in Astros' 5-2 win over Marlins
